summary: Comprehensive testing of CAPEX Portal iteration 28 features: Complete LoginPage redesign with space-themed dark mode, 3D rotating bearing animation, pull-lamp with dark↔lit transitions, 'Made by Saurabh Jangir' branding, Buyer→Capex Head mapping validation, User→DH mapping, GET /api/admin/capex-heads endpoint, 'Mapped To' column in user table, and Settings page theme picker for all users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration 28 features tested and working. LoginPage has complete space-themed redesign with: dark background with stars/dust particles/nebula, 3D rotating bearing animation (data-testid='bearing-animation'), pull-lamp with 'PULL TO ILLUMINATE' text (data-testid='pull-cord'), clicking pull cord transitions to lit mode with multicolor background/glowing bearing/amber login button/'PULL TO DIM' text, 'Made by Saurabh Jangir' footer (data-testid='creator-branding'). Admin login redirects to /admin, other roles redirect to /dashboard. Admin Dashboard Users tab has 'Mapped To' column showing person name and role. Create User form: Role=User shows Plant+Dept+Map to DH (all mandatory), Role=Buyer shows Map to Capex Head (purple border, mandatory), Role=DH shows Plant+Dept (no Map to DH), Role=Capex Head shows no extra fields. Backend validates: buyer without mapped_dh_id returns 400, user without plant/dept/mapped_dh_id returns 400. GET /api/admin/capex-heads returns list of capex heads. Settings page theme picker available for all users with 14 theme options.
